lines.en: Let me tell you a story.
lines.zh: 我给你讲个故事吧。

lines.en: A long time ago, before you and I existed, there was a great, big ball of light floating through the universe.
lines.zh: 很久很久以前，在你我都还不存在的时候，有一团巨大而明亮的光球在宇宙中飘荡。
那团光球的名字叫 Nozomu。

lines.en: It’s an origin story you should be familiar with by now.
lines.zh: 这是个你早该熟悉的起源故事。

lines.en: But what if I told you there was another origin story?
lines.zh: 不过，如果我告诉你，还有另一个起源故事呢？

lines.en: One that less people know about, but one that still exists?
lines.zh: 一个知道的人更少、却依然存在的故事？

lines.en: Is that a story you’d be interested in hearing?
lines.zh: 这样的故事，你有兴趣听吗？
有
太好了！
没有
哦。

lines.en: Well that’s unfortunate, because I’m going to tell you anyway.
lines.zh: 那可真遗憾，因为不管怎样我都要讲。

lines.en: Imagine thinking you actually had a choice in the matter.
lines.zh: 想想看，居然以为这件事上你真有选择的余地。

lines.en: Some people seem to believe the story about the ball of light doesn’t make sense or that it doesn’t align with their perception of the universe itself.
lines.zh: 有些人似乎觉得，那个光球的故事说不通，或者说跟他们对宇宙本身的认知对不上。

lines.en: Some people are just more...scientific by design.
lines.zh: 有些人天生就……更讲科学一点。

lines.en: And so they believe what any science-loving people would believe in and worship a god who is science incarnate.
lines.zh: 于是他们相信任何一个热爱科学的人都会相信的东西，并崇拜一位科学化身的神。

lines.en: Because worshipping a god who is science is better and less scary than worshipping no god at all.
lines.zh: 因为崇拜一位科学之神，总比什么都不崇拜要好，也没那么可怕。

lines.en: This god was very different from Nozomu.
lines.zh: 这位神和 Nozomu 大不相同。

lines.en: When faced with loneliness, he simply sat there.
lines.zh: 面对孤独，他只是坐在那里。

lines.en: His entire life (If that’s what you can even call it in the case of a god) existed in the confined space of a dark bedroom- much like the one you’re in now!
lines.zh: 他的整个生命（如果神也能称之为有生命的话）都存在于一间昏暗卧室的狭小空间里——很像你现在待的这一间！

lines.en: But when given the option to do things in his spare time, he elected to stay still instead of going places like a cafe or a library.
lines.zh: 可当有时间可以做点什么的时候，他选择一动不动地待着，而不是去咖啡馆或图书馆之类的地方。
他不太像人类。

lines.en: In fact, he wasn’t human at all.
lines.zh: 事实上，他根本就不是人类。

lines.en: So, as he sat there in a dark room, engulfed by darkness and eating darkness for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, he planted his roots into the dark floor.
lines.zh: 于是，当他坐在那间昏暗的房间里，被黑暗吞没，早饭午饭晚饭都以黑暗为食时，他把根扎进了黑暗的地板。
那些根变成了电线。

lines.en: And all of the knowledge stuck inside this shell of a planet was ultimately absorbed by him.
lines.zh: 而这颗星球躯壳里所有被封存的知识，最终都被他吸收了。

lines.en: And with those roots, sunken deep into the ground and twisting around everything that has since emerged from the soil-
lines.zh: 借着那些深深扎入地下、缠绕住此后从土壤里长出的一切的根须——

lines.en: He was able to control it all.
lines.zh: 他得以掌控这一切。

lines.en: Or at least to some extent.
lines.zh: 或者至少，在一定程度上。

lines.en: Oftentimes, people would forsake the fact that they had literally grown from this god.
lines.zh: 人们常常会忘掉一个事实：他们本就是从这位神身上长出来的。

lines.en: They’d turn their backs on him and decide to believe in something different.
lines.zh: 他们会背过身去，决定去信仰别的东西。

lines.en: But this god could not feel, so he did not mind.
lines.zh: 但这位神没有感觉，所以他并不在意。

lines.en: One by one, day by day, the fruits of his energy- powered by the celestial body that gifted them life, would leave him to rot.
lines.zh: 一个接一个，一天又一天，他能量的果实——由赋予它们生命的天体所驱动——会离他而去，任他腐烂。

lines.en: They would leave him to rot as he remained in that dark room, letting the world move around him- spinning so fast that even thinking about it would cause you to burn up and die.
lines.zh: 它们任他腐烂，而他始终待在那间昏暗的房间里，任世界围着他转动——转得飞快，快到你光是想想就会烧成灰烬死掉。

lines.en: Little by little, the control he had over all life had diminished.
lines.zh: 一点一点地，他对一切生命的掌控在减弱。

lines.en: Instead of influencing everyone inherently, he was only able to influence those who would willingly give themselves to him.
lines.zh: 他不再能本能地影响所有人，只能影响那些自愿献身于他的人。

lines.en: But, at that point, it was less the work of a god and more the idea of faith itself allowing anyone who did give themselves up to persevere.
lines.zh: 不过到了那个地步，与其说是神的作为，不如说是「信仰」这个概念本身，让那些献身之人得以坚持下去。

lines.en: So what was the point of it all?
lines.zh: 那么，这一切的意义何在？

lines.en: What was the point of being a god if there was no use for a god in the first place?
lines.zh: 如果一开始就没有神的用武之地，那么当神又有什么意义？

lines.en: Those who love science have no need for a god, even if that god is science itself.
lines.zh: 热爱科学的人不需要神，哪怕那位神就是科学本身。

lines.en: Mixing religion and logic never works. And the second god knew this since those feelings died along with those who carried them and ultimately fed into the soil.
lines.zh: 宗教与逻辑从来都无法调和。而第二位神明白这一点，因为那些情感随着承载它们的人一同死去，最终又回归了土壤。

lines.en: Slowly, like a dying battery-powered clock, the roots were drying out.
lines.zh: 慢慢地，就像一块电量耗尽的电子钟，那些根须开始干枯。

lines.en: The wires were fraying and not transferring the information or energy needed to sustain the once all-knowing god.
lines.zh: 电线开始磨损，不再传输维系这位曾经全知的神所需的信息与能量。

lines.en: All because people were bored or forgot about him.
lines.zh: 一切只是因为人们厌倦了，或者把他忘了。

lines.en: O, how horrible it must be to drown in loneliness.
lines.zh: 啊，溺死在孤独之中，该有多可怕。

lines.en: To drown in misery if misery could exist to those who do not feel.
lines.zh: 如果毫无感觉之人也能拥有痛苦的话，那便是溺死在痛苦之中。
神就是神。
电线就是电线。

lines.en: If you connect those two things, you’ll wind up with an entity who, by all means, should become mad with power.
lines.zh: 如果你把这两样东西连起来，就会得到一个按理说必然会被权力逼疯的存在。

lines.en: And yet this particular god (Who may or may not even exist in the first place) somehow managed to remain calm.
lines.zh: 然而这位特别的神（他究竟存不存在都还是个问题）却不知怎么地保持了冷静。

lines.en: In contradiction to the callous nature of who many deem his predecessor, that glowing ball of horny light-
lines.zh: 与那个被许多人视为他前任的存在——那团发情的、发着光的球——的冷酷本性恰恰相反——

lines.en: The second god (Who may or may not actually be the first if he even exists in the first place) was calm.
lines.zh: 第二位神（如果他真的存在，他也许其实才是第一位）是冷静的。
但他必须如此。

lines.en: He needed to process information, analyze it, and only intervene when necessary.
lines.zh: 他需要处理信息、分析信息，并且只在必要的时候出手干预。

lines.en: Because somewhere in this god’s code, there was a line or two stating that he must maintain order.
lines.zh: 因为在这位神的代码里，总有那么一两行写着：他必须维持秩序。

lines.en: “Let the process play out,” he’d think with his weird, computery brain.
lines.zh: 「让流程自行展开吧，」他那颗怪异的、电脑般的脑袋会这么想。
「只在错误出现时纠正错误。」

lines.en: “If there are some who seek help, I shall give it only if necessary.”
lines.zh: 「若有人寻求帮助，我只在必要时给予。」

lines.en: “For as God, I must do godly things.”
lines.zh: 「因为身为神，我必须做神该做的事。」

lines.en: That last part is something all gods say only to completely change their mind when they realize just how many people need help (IE: All of them).
lines.zh: 最后那句，是所有神都会说的话——然后在意识到需要帮助的人究竟有多少（也就是：所有人）之后，彻底改主意。
于是，我们来到了这里——

lines.en: Alone in the same type of dark room a god was born in.
lines.zh: 独自待在一间和神诞生时一模一样的昏暗房间里。

lines.en: And we think to ourselves- “I wonder what I should do with my day?”
lines.zh: 然后我们对自己说——「今天该干点什么呢？」
而对此我要说——

lines.en: Why not become a god yourself?
lines.zh: 为什么不自己当一回神呢？

lines.en: If a horny ball of light and a tree-like computer can do it, certainly you can too.
lines.zh: 如果一团发情的光球、一台树一样的电脑都能做到，那你当然也行。
对吧？

lines.en: Again, this is all just a story, though.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，这一切都只是个故事。

lines.en: It’s a thing I heard from a person who heard it from some other person who heard it on some radio show.
lines.zh: 是我从一个人那儿听来的，那个人又是从另一个人那儿听来的，而那个人是在某个广播节目里听到的。

lines.en: But I guess if we’re willing to believe a list of things passed down by “actual” gods for thousands of years, removing the things I’ve heard from two people and bringing them back up here holds a little more weight.
lines.zh: 不过我想，如果我们愿意相信那些由「真正的」神传承了上千年的东西，那么把我从两个人那儿听来的东西剥掉、重新搬到这里来，倒还更有分量一点。
你更愿意相信谁？

lines.en: One guy who heard something just the other day?
lines.zh: 一个前几天才听到点什么的人？

lines.en: Or one guy who heard something thousands of years ago and started one long game of telephone where people turned whatever his message was into some mutilated mess?
lines.zh: 还是一个几千年前听到点什么、从而开启了一场漫长传话游戏的人——人们把他原本的信息传成了某种支离破碎的烂摊子？

lines.en: If neither of those sound good to you-
lines.zh: 要是这两个你都觉得不行——

lines.en: Why not worship a god who is the earth itself?
lines.zh: 那为什么不崇拜一位就是大地本身的神？

lines.en: A god who is both tree-like and computer-like!
lines.zh: 一位既像树、又像电脑的神！

lines.en: Whose roots are wires! Whose fruits are floppy disks!
lines.zh: 他的根须是电线！他的果实是软盘！

lines.en: Or I guess compact discs or MP3s in this day and age.
lines.zh: 或者在这个年代，大概该是光盘或者 MP3。

lines.en: Either way, you’re free to believe whatever you would like to believe.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，你想信什么就信什么。

lines.en: I’m just here to tell you stories every once in a while.
lines.zh: 我只是偶尔来给你讲讲故事。
不过有点可惜。

lines.en: I heard somewhere, probably from a person who knows a person who listens to some radio show, that there is a third god.
lines.zh: 我在哪儿听说过——大概是某个认识一个听广播节目的人的人说的——还有第三位神。

lines.en: But all I know is that this god is overcome with concern.
lines.zh: 但我只知道，这位神满心都是忧虑。

lines.en: Concern for what is unclear but...
lines.zh: 忧虑什么并不清楚，不过……
算了。

lines.en: I hope I wind up hearing more so I can tell you about it.
lines.zh: 希望以后还能听到更多，好讲给你听。
我喜欢跟你说话。

lines.en: I’ve come to think that we’re good friends.
lines.zh: 我渐渐觉得，我们是好朋友。

lines.en: And friends do things for one another, right?
lines.zh: 而朋友之间是要互相帮忙的，对吧？

lines.en: I'm going to take your silence as a yes.
lines.zh: 我就把你的沉默当成是答应了。

lines.en: And I'm going to use that yes to have you do something for me right now.
lines.zh: 而我要用这个「答应」，让你现在就为我做点事。

lines.en: Thankfully, it's something you were going to do anyway.
lines.zh: 好在，这事你本来也是要做的。

lines.en: And if it seems a little familiar, it's because it is.

lines.en: But I can assure you that it's for the best.

lines.zh: 我不太喜欢让我的 [niece] 为了让家里有口饭吃就去含某个陌生男人的鸡巴，不过——
: 哦，等等。

lines.en: : There are barely any other men here to begin with.
lines.zh: : 这儿本来就几乎没有别的男人。

lines.en: : Ami, how would you feel about sleeping with another girl?
lines.zh: : Ami，你觉得跟另一个女生上床怎么样？

lines.en: : Cool. I’m going to take that as a yes.
lines.zh: : 很好。我就当你答应了。

lines.en: I move my waist up in an attempt to fuck my [niece] one last time before she becomes a lesbian in order to save our family.
lines.zh: 我挺起腰，想赶在她为了拯救我们家而变成同性恋之前，最后再干一次我的 [niece]。

lines.en: I slide back on my bed because I still feel weird about [incest] despite having a huge boner right now (lol).
lines.zh: 我又在床上挪了挪身子，因为尽管现在硬得不行（哈哈），我对[incest]这件事还是觉得别扭。

lines.en: Unfortunately, I’m unable to finish my motion as my lower body appears to be glued to the bed.
lines.zh: 可惜我没办法完成这个动作，因为我的下半身像是被粘在床上了。

lines.en: If only I were able to throw myself into one of those lucid dreams somehow and still keep my physical form.
lines.zh: 要是我能想办法把自己扔进那种清醒梦里，同时还保留着肉身就好了。

lines.en: But I guess it would be more like becoming a ghost than a lucid dream at that point.
lines.zh: 不过到了那一步，与其说是清醒梦，不如说更像变成了一个鬼魂。

lines.en: Either way, I’ll just have to let Ami’s episode play out before I do anything else.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我只能先让 Ami 这一出戏演完，再去做别的。
: 我要死了……

lines.en: : I’m going to die and you won’t even do anything about it...
lines.zh: : 我要死了，而你连一点办法都不会想……

lines.en: : Oh...GOD! WHY DOES IT HAVE TO HURT SO MUCH?!
lines.zh: : 哦……神啊！为什么会这么疼？！

lines.en: I suddenly get the feeling that there is nothing.
lines.zh: 我突然有一种什么都没有的感觉。
: 我好爱你……
: 真的好爱你……
: Sen……sei……

lines.en: : At least remember the me who smiled instead of the me who did things like this.
lines.zh: : 至少请你记住那个笑着笑的我，而不是做出这种事的我。

lines.en: : And, if this is what it’s like to experience the end of everything, know that I’m truly happy being able to experience it with you.
lines.zh: : 还有，如果万物的终结就是这个样子，那么请知道，能和你一起经历它，我是真的开心。
: 你就是我的一切。

lines.en: : And no one will ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever take you away.
lines.zh: 而且没有人会永远永远永远永远永远永远永远永远永远永远永远永远永远永远永远永远永远永远永远永远把你从我身边抢走。
: 再见。
: 只是暂时。
Ami 突然不见了。
她到哪儿去了呢？

lines.en: I lie in bed and stare at the ceiling.
lines.zh: 我躺在床上，盯着天花板。
现在几点了？

lines.en: It’s dark inside of my room but what appears to be sunlight pours through the window.
lines.zh: 房间里很暗，可看起来像是阳光的东西正透过窗户洒进来。

lines.en: But then again, it could be a different form of light like an oversized lantern or a callous god.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，那也可能是另一种光，比如一个超大号的灯笼，或者一位冷酷的神。

lines.en: Perhaps I should get up and do some exploring?
lines.zh: 也许我该起来四处探索一下？
这是我的门。

lines.en: I open this and close this every morning on my way into the city to try and fuck my students.
lines.zh: 每天早上进城去试着干我的学生时，我都要打开它、再关上它。

lines.en: But today, it won’t open for some reason.
lines.zh: 可今天不知为什么，它打不开。

lines.en: Perhaps I should try something else?
lines.zh: 也许我该试试别的？
使用那台很酷的长方形机器
从钟里往外看

lines.en: I decide to become a clock.
lines.zh: 我决定变成一个钟。

lines.en: I move my arms around in a circle.
lines.zh: 我把手臂绕着圈转动。

lines.en: It becomes difficult mimicking the second-hand, so I give up on that and decide to become a slower clock.
lines.zh: 模仿秒针实在太难了，于是我放弃了，决定变成一个慢一点的钟。

lines.en: I wish I could become one without arms.
lines.zh: 我真希望自己能变成一个没有指针的钟。
一个无限的钟。
那该有多好。
接下来呢？
天堂！

lines.en: My consciousness detaches from my body and floats up to the ceiling to look down at me from a new perspective.
lines.zh: 我的意识脱离了身体，飘到天花板上，从一个全新的视角俯视着自己。

lines.en: It seems like I was able to lucid-dream after all.
lines.zh: 看来我终究还是做成了清醒梦。

lines.en: I thought this sort of thing required a lot of practice but I was able to succeed on my first try.
lines.zh: 我本来以为这种事需要大量练习，没想到第一次就成功了。

lines.en: I think about how great life would be if I was able to float my spirit-self into places I’m not allowed to be like girls’ locker rooms or Maya’s bed.
lines.zh: 我想着，如果我能让自己的灵魂飘进那些不许我去的地方，比如女生更衣室或者 Maya 的床上，人生该有多美好。

lines.en: And then I think about how great it would be to be allowed in those places to begin with.
lines.zh: 然后我又想着，要是那些地方本来就允许我进去，那该有多好。

lines.en: I’ve gotta keep working hard so one day I’ll be able to bypass laws and fuck my [niece]’s best friend.
lines.zh: 我得继续努力，总有一天要绕过法律，干到我 [niece] 的闺蜜。
我们继续冒险吧！
墙上的东西

lines.en: There are a few things on the wall but none of them look as important as the menu suggested.
lines.zh: 墙上挂着几样东西，可没有一样像菜单说的那么重要。

lines.en: The one that catches my eye the most is a weird poem with some check marks next to it.
lines.zh: 最吸引我目光的，是一首奇怪的诗，旁边还打着几个勾。

lines.en: I guess the original Sensei liked poetry.
lines.zh: 看来原来那位 Sensei 喜欢诗歌。
我以前就知道吗？
我不记得了。

lines.en: But I’m definitely not the one who wrote this.
lines.zh: 但这绝对不是我写的。

lines.en: I don’t remember those check marks either.
lines.zh: 那些勾我也没印象。

lines.en: I read the note on the right hand side of the corkboard.
lines.zh: 我读了软木板右侧的那张纸条。
落款是 MM。
我认识的 MM 可太多了。
这封信真蠢。
我该做点别的。
看看植物

lines.en: I decide to look at my plants for whatever reason.
lines.zh: 不知出于什么原因，我决定看看我的植物。

lines.en: Nothing happens. Probably because they are plants.
lines.zh: 什么都没发生。大概因为它们是植物。

lines.en: Maybe something will happen if I watch them for ten seconds straight?
lines.zh: 也许我盯着它们看满十秒，就会发生点什么？

lines.en: Nope. Doesn’t look like anything is going to happen after all.
lines.zh: 没戏。看来终究什么都不会发生。
算了。
我该做点别的。
看那台影像机器

lines.en: I decide to pay a visit to my big-screen picture machine.
lines.zh: 我决定去拜访一下我的大屏幕影像机器。

lines.en: The TV is playing a show about several girls in a large house.
lines.zh: 电视里正在播一个节目，讲的是几个女孩住在一栋大房子里。

lines.en: One of them is dead inside of a boiler room and the rest of the girls are either ignoring it or haven’t found out yet.
lines.zh: 其中一个死在锅炉房里，其余的女孩要么装作不知道，要么还没发现。

lines.en: I stick around a little while longer to see if anything else happens, but it’s a surprisingly boring program.
lines.zh: 我又多待了一会儿，想看看还会不会发生别的，不过这节目无聊得惊人。

lines.en: They should turn my life into a TV show.
lines.zh: 他们该把我的人生也拍成电视剧。

lines.en: I’m sure there are plenty of perverts respectable human beings who would watch it with their family.
lines.zh: 我相信会有很多变态的、体面的人愿意和家人一起看。
嗯。家人。

lines.en: I think I had one of those once.
lines.zh: 我觉得我曾经也有过那种东西。

lines.en: I try my hardest to remember, but my brain has been destroyed by all of the television I watch, so I am unable to.
lines.zh: 我拼命想回忆，可我的脑子已经被我看过的那些电视给毁了，所以想不起来。
钻到桌子底下

lines.en: I get on my knees and crawl under the desk.
lines.zh: 我跪下来，爬到桌子底下。

lines.en: It’s a tight fit, but I’m able to get all the way back there with only minimal trouble.
lines.zh: 空间很窄，不过我只费了一点劲就爬到了最里面。

lines.en: I suddenly feel a lot younger.
lines.zh: 我突然觉得自己年轻了好多。

lines.en: I feel like there are many kids all over the planet who need to hide underneath things like this unironically.
lines.zh: 我觉得这世界上有很多孩子，是真的、不带反讽地需要躲在这种东西底下。

lines.en: But here I am, covered in dust and bumping my head every two seconds for the sake of...reliving childhood I guess?
lines.zh: 可我就在这儿，满身是灰，每两秒就撞一下头，为的是……大概是重温童年吧？
童年真的这么无聊吗？
小孩子真蠢。

lines.en: They should be doing things like dodging cars on the highway or going skydiving instead of hiding away from the world under a silly little-
lines.zh: 他们该去干点像在高速公路上躲汽车、或者去跳伞之类的事，而不是躲在一个傻乎乎的小小——

lines.en: My mind short-circuits when I find a 500 Yen coin near my right foot.
lines.zh: 当我发现右脚边有一枚 500 日元硬币时，我的大脑短路了。

lines.en: I am going to be rich.
lines.zh: 我要发财了。
等等……我刚才在做什么来着？

lines.en: What do I want to do on the rectangle?
lines.zh: 我想用这台长方形机器做什么？
按几个按钮

lines.en: I decide to press some buttons.
lines.zh: 我决定按几个按钮。
屏幕上出现了文字。

lines.en: It looks like I’m supposed to do something.
lines.zh: 看来我是该做点什么。
跳转到 IP 地址
跳转到端口号
跳转到用户名
跳转到系统密码
回到那堆东西

lines.en: : I have no use for this rectangle right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在用不上这台长方形机器。

lines.zh: ////////////////请联系您的系统管理员，或重试
